title: TCS A2A identity extension params (proposal)
description: Data-only params for capabilities.extensions[] with URI https://topodacharts.com/a2a/extensions/tcs-identity/v1. The URI is an identifier; it is not verified as deployed.

badge.description: Current exact TCS technical badge from the canonical identity record.

displayName.description: Canonical display name, not a nickname or badge alias.

hairDescription.description: Optional public approved visual descriptor; never inferred.

portraitUrl.description: Optional approved public portrait URL; never include private Drive links.
